reason: The named lab and a report for each batch is what I actually look for, and 200 mg elemental bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. The money-back guarantee with nothing to ship back makes one box at $24.99 a low-risk try before bed.
objection: No reviews yet, so I can't tell if anyone actually sleeps or feels better on it. I'd want to open the lab report and check it is real before I pay.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be vague, missing a batch number, or the lab couldn't be found, I'd pass.
